entries.name: ValidatorTimelock
entries.description: Intermediary contract between the *Validators* and the central diamond contract that delays block execution (ie withdrawals and other L2 --> L1 messages) by at least 3h. Duration could be configured individually for zk stack chains by chain admins. All delays are capped at 30 days.

executionDelay.description: Ecosystem-wide minimum execution delay (in seconds), set by the owner. The delay enforced for a chain is the maximum of this value and the chain-specific delay.

executionDelay_fmt.description: Ecosystem-wide minimum execution delay, set by the owner. The delay enforced for a chain is the maximum of this value and the chain-specific delay.

upgradeTimestamps.description: Timestamps for new protocol version upgrades can be registered here (NOT enforced)

entries.name: Diamond
entries.description: The main contract defining the Layer 2. Operator actions like commiting blocks, providing ZK proofs and executing batches ultimately target this contract which then processes transactions. During batch execution it processes L1 --> L2 and L2 --> L1 transactions.

getSettlementLayer.description: Settlement layer for this chain: the zero address while batches are committed, proven and executed on Ethereum, otherwise the Gateway diamond that settles this chain. Moving it relocates the complete proof-verification and message path of the chain.

getTransactionFilterer.description: This contract must expose the ITransactionFilterer interface (see Mailbox facet) and is used for censoring transactions pushed from L1 to L2.

IsPorterAvailableStatus.description: zkPorter is a volition-like contruction and changes the zk proof input requirements.

isPermanentRollup.description: true means that the DA mode cannot be changed to Validium in the future. compliant DAValidator pairs for the permanent rollup mode are defined/enforced by the RollupDAManager contract.

priorityModeCanBeActivated.description: 1 once the chain admin permanently allowed Priority Mode (ZKsync OS permanent rollups only). Then anyone can activate it as soon as the first unprocessed priority transaction is older than 4 days, after which only the shared PermissionlessValidator can settle batches (anyone can submit through it) and only the ChainTypeManager owner can deactivate it.

priorityModeInfo.description: Raw Priority Mode storage: last byte canBeActivated, byte before it activated, then the PermissionlessValidator address.

priorityModeTransactionFilterer.description: TransactionFilterer that replaces the chain's own filterer once Priority Mode is allowed. Set by the ChainTypeManager owner, zero means no filtering.

getDAValidatorPair.description: l1da, l2da (before v31) or l1da, L2 DA commitment scheme (from v31).

getProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version, increments with each protocol upgrade.

getVerifierParams.description: Verifier parameters used for proving batches.

arg.1: . isPermanentRollup was set to true in this contract which prevents changing the DA mode to Validium in the future.
